packet_dag.terminal_condition: The packet is complete when member-library Vimeo players lazy-activate, newest/material/worksheet filters are present, focused tests pass, and deployment/live smoke either passes or is explicitly blocked.

title: One Time Member Library Performance And Filter Fix

reasons: The operator reported laggy app/button behavior.
Static inspection found eager Vimeo iframes and full-grid rerenders on the One Time member library.
The first implementation batch can safely reduce local UI work without external provider writes.
ramble_router.next_exact_packet: Create the media security/slides/worksheets packet after this performance/filter batch is verified.

operator_intent_summary: Make the One Time member library feel faster and easier to browse by reducing heavy video initialization and adding clear newest/material filters.
raw_quotes: the entire app is extremely laggy
the buttons like click and it just lags
make sure there's proper filters so they can see what's the newest one that's uploaded
out_of_scope: No Drive upload, Vimeo upload, Vimeo privacy mutation, email/WhatsApp/Telegram send, payment, access grant, or public publish.
No classroom-code auth rewrite, slides/worksheets schema change, or moderated public-comment implementation in this packet.
No claim that lazy private embeds fully prevent copying or screen recording.

inspection_targets: One Time member-library current-state audit screenshots and metrics
observed: The live audit produced route screenshots but member-library TEST access returned 401 and zero cards, so populated live evidence remains caveated.
Static inspection found Vimeo iframes mounted directly for each Vimeo card.
Static inspection found search input re-rendering the library on every keystroke.
Existing filters did not include first-class Materials or Worksheets views.
known_blockers: Live populated member-library smoke depends on valid TEST access and deployment.

expanded_phrases.extremely laggy: Avoid initializing media players or rebuilding heavy DOM until the user explicitly opens a lesson.
expanded_phrases.buttons click and it lags: Filter/search/progress actions should update visible UI without remounting every video player.
expanded_phrases.proper filters: Filters should include all, newest, continue watching, Masechta, Perek, materials, worksheets, review, and completed.
expanded_phrases.newest one that's uploaded: Newest is a first-class filter label sorted by published/class date.

product_quality_expansion.first_party_pattern_interpretation: Keep One Time member-library access and progress APIs intact while improving browser-side rendering.

requirements.statement: Reduce One Time member-library visible lag by lazy-activating media players.
requirements.expected_result: Vimeo iframes do not mount until a member clicks Play Video, while progress tracking still records open/progress events.
acceptance_criteria: No Vimeo iframe is present in the synthetic library card before Play Video.
Play Video activates the embedded player and preserves access-code scoped progress tracking.
Search/filter/progress behavior does not reset security or expose raw Vimeo download links.

requirements.expected_result: The library exposes clear Newest, Materials, and Worksheets filters alongside existing progress and Mishnah navigation filters.
acceptance_criteria: Filter rail includes All, Newest, Continue Watching, Masechta, Perek, Materials, Worksheets, Review, and Completed.
Search includes asset titles/types and is debounced.
Mobile filter rail stays horizontally usable without page overflow.

criteria: Raw intake is preserved as RAW-20260708-006.
External Drive/Vimeo provider writes are explicitly out of scope.
Implementation is limited to the member-library browser surface and proof harness.
Access control, progress API contract, and member-safe field filtering remain unchanged.

filtered_empty.accessibility_expectation: Debounced search does not block input focus.

findings.user_impact: Eager media-player mounting can make library filters/buttons feel slow as video count grows.
findings.expected_fix: Lazy-activate video players only when a member clicks Play Video.

findings.user_impact: Filter rail did not expose clear materials/worksheet paths requested by the operator.
findings.expected_fix: Add clear Newest, Materials, and Worksheets filter labels while preserving mobile horizontal rail usability.

accessibility.baseline: WCAG 2.2 A/AA plus responsive touch-target and no-overlap checks.
required_checks: Play Video button has visible text
mobile filter rail does not create page overflow
private video preview does not trap keyboard focus

action_states.label: Play Video
action_states.handler_or_blocker: Activates the local embedded media player and records member-library progress through the existing scoped API.

action_states.label: Newest filter
action_states.handler_or_blocker: Sorts visible items by published/class date without external writes.

action_states.handler_or_blocker: Shows items with class assets already returned by the member-safe API.

action_states.label: Worksheets filter
action_states.handler_or_blocker: Shows items with worksheet/source-sheet assets already returned by the member-safe API.

action_states.label: Mark Complete
action_states.handler_or_blocker: Uses existing /api/member-library/items/:id/progress endpoint scoped by access code.

data_requirements: member library item id/title/class date/published date

scope_rules: Only the One Time member-library browser surface is changed.
No raw Vimeo direct link is shown for Vimeo-hosted member videos.
Member access-code progress scoping remains unchanged.
Assets shown are only those already returned by the member-safe API.
forbidden_content: raw video download link for Vimeo items

implementation_batches.scope: Member-library lazy media and filter fix
instructions: Do not alter server access-control or publish rules.
Render Vimeo and HTML5 video players only after Play Video.
Add Newest, Materials, and Worksheets filter paths.
Update focused tests and smoke expectations.
